references.text: Moses warns that curses will come upon Israel if they are disobedient, just as blessings come through obedience.
The Lord warns that He will uproot the people from the land if they are disobedient, just as He delighted in doing them good.
Confirmation that not one word of all the good promises the Lord had given to Israel has failed.
Joshua testifies that all the Lord's good promises have been fulfilled, providing context for the warning in verse 15.
Solomon confirms that not one word of all the Lord's good promises through Moses has failed.
God is not a human being who lies; what He has said, He will do.
Detailed warnings about punishment and destruction that will come upon Israel due to disobedience.
Moses warns that they will be cut off from the land if they turn to idolatry.
The Lord confirms that His word will stand, whether for judgment or salvation.
The Lord's words and laws reached the fathers, and they had to repent and acknowledge the Lord's righteousness.
